trigger: PUB-P2E04 established that the shared soil-water solve-result residual has route-dependent physical dimensions: Reference publishes a HeadCalc equation-balance rate residual while RossFast publishes an integrated water-balance residual.

legacy_field.name: unrounded_mass_balance_residual
legacy_field.policy: retain unchanged route-specific numeric value for compatibility, but treat as deprecated/ambiguous and do not use in new cross-solver publication gates

integrated_field.name: integrated_mass_balance_residual_cm
integrated_field.semantics: solver-level time-integrated water-balance/equation-balance residual; not the canonical transaction mass ledger

native_rate_field.name: native_balance_rate_residual_cm_per_day
native_rate_field.semantics: solver-native equation-balance rate residual; Reference exposes exact final HeadCalc residual sum, RossFast leaves unavailable unless independently defined

reference_binding_rule: For qualified accepted Reference bottom modes 2 and 5, preserve the historical legacy-field value as the exact final HeadCalc residual sum, expose the same value as the native rate residual, and expose step_duration times that value as the integrated residual in cm.
rossfast_binding_rule: Preserve the historical legacy-field value exactly and expose that same integrated value through the typed cm field; do not synthesize a native rate residual.
publication_requalification: PUB-P2E01 cross-solver mass gates must require typed integrated residual availability and compare only the cm-valued integrated residuals against the existing RossFast hard mass tolerance in cm. Head/theta/storage disagreement metrics remain unchanged.
prohibited_changes: no investigation or repair of the 103 PUB-P2E04 RETRY_LOCAL_BAL cases
no rewriting of PUB-P2E03 or PUB-P2E04 immutable result history
qualification: focused PUB-P2E01 O0/O2 paired-pilot replay with byte-identical optimization outputs
full F-CI canonical qualification on the PR merge image
